name: Actuators & Drive Trains for Robots and Machines
summary: Choosing and designing the motor, transmission and compliance that turn electrical or fluid power into controlled, power-dense mechanical motion.

topics.name: Actuator figures of merit: torque/force density, power density, bandwidth, efficiency, backdrivability
Electric motor physics for mechanical designers: torque constant, torque-speed curves, thermal limits
Motor and gear-ratio selection; inertia matching and reflected inertia
High-ratio reducers for robots: planetary, harmonic and cycloidal trade-offs
Linear actuation: ball screws, roller screws, belts and rack-and-pinion
Cable and tendon drives, Bowden cables and capstan transmissions
Hydraulic vs electric vs pneumatic actuation for mobile and wearable robots
Actuator thermal modeling and duty-cycle rating
Clutches, brakes and mechanical safety features in actuators
Integrated actuator module design (motor, gearbox, encoder, driver, torque sensing)
